progression.label: Progression
progression.help: Chords separated by spaces. Add :N for N beats (default 4), e.g. Am Dm7 G7:2 C/G:2
progression.invalid: Not recognised: {{tokens}}. Try for example C, Am, G7, Cmaj7, Bm7b5, Esus4, C/G.
progression.empty: Type at least one chord, for example: C G Am F

stage.label: Voice lines of the chord progression. Drag a line up or down to change that note.
stage.hint: Drag a line to change a note · Drag the background or use the wheel to move in time · Ctrl+wheel to zoom · Click a chord to hear it

discardEdits.detail: Changing the progression creates new voices and discards the notes you edited by hand. You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.
